product_summary: Ahmedabad-based (C 911-912, Swati Trinity, Applewoods Township, SP Ring Road, Shela, Ahmedabad 380058) manufacturer/supplier of refractories and insulation. Confirmed product lines from own website (horizonrefractories.com): (1) Refractory fire bricks, high alumina bricks, insulating fire bricks, acid-resistant bricks, basic refractories — HS 6902.10/6902.20/6902.90; (2) Refractory castables — high alumina dense castables and light-weight insulating castables/concretes — HS 3816.00; (3) Refractory mortar and acid-resistant mortar — HS 3816.00; (4) High alumina / calcium aluminate cement, grades H-CEM-50 (Al2O3 50% min) and H-CEM-70 (Al2O3 72% min) — HS 2523.30 (calcium aluminate cement); (5) Ceramic fibre blankets, boards, modules, bulk fibre (1260C and 1425C grades) — HS 6806.10/6806.90; (6) Ceramic balls / inert alumina catalyst support balls, grades HRPL-25 (19-26% Al2O3), HRPL-50 (40-45% Al2O3), HRPL-99 (99% Al2O3) — HS 6909.19 or 6903.20 depending on alumina content; (7) Calcium silicate boards — HS 6810.99/6811.82; (8) Industrial minerals (raw). Declared codes 381600 (refractory cements, mortars, concretes) and 690320 (refractory ceramic goods, alumina/silica >50%) cover only lines (2)/(3) and part of (1) — they are correct but incomplete.
role_hint: manufacturer (self-described manufacturer with own branded grades HRPL-25/50/99, H-CEM-50/70, ISO 9001/14001/45001 claims, private-label/white-label offer). Trader signs present: site markets itself to 'wholesalers, retailers and dealers worldwide', offers private branding under NDA, and lists 'Industrial Minerals' as a resale-type line — so manufacturer_trader is plausible for part of the range. comment: HS-6 mapping vs declaration: 381600 — exact match (refractory castables, mortars, high alumina cement used as refractory binder). 690320 — partial match (covers high-alumina bricks and alumina ceramic balls >50% Al2O3, but not fireclay/insulating/acid-resistant bricks which sit in 6902.10/6902.20/6902.90). Missing from declaration: calcium aluminate / high alumina cement H-CEM-50 and H-CEM-70 (2523.30) — a distinct, technically specified product line with published Al2O3 and CCS data; ceramic fibre blanket/board/module/bulk fibre (6806.10/6806.90); calcium silicate boards (6810.99/6811.82); low/medium purity ceramic balls HRPL-25 and HRPL-50 (6909.19, since Al2O3 19-45% is below the 50% threshold of 6903.20); industrial minerals (Ch. 25). Industry classification 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' is only partly right: the site's own 'Industries Served' list is sugar factories, cement plants, ceramic plants, steel plants, chimney lining, food industry — i.e. this is a refractory/insulation materials maker serving metallurgy among others, not a mining or metals producer. No HS mismatch is treated as a rejection ground: company is retained and codes corrected per Rule 3. All product data above is from the company's own website pages (home, /refractory-castables.html, /high-alumina-cement.html, /ceramic-fiber.html, /ceramic-balls.html) — no customs line, B/L or GST record was reviewed in this pass, therefore actual shipments and the export claim ('customers in more than 30 countries') are marked 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Revenue, export volume, PAN, CIN and state: null — not researched in this role and not public on the pages read.
